seo.heading: How the Bike Weather Planner works
seo.intro: Bike Weather helps you find the right clothing and gear for your next ride — based on real-time weather along your entire route. Simply enter your tour details and receive a personalized recommendation.
seo.startLocationDesc: The starting point of your route. You can search for an address or use your current GPS location. Weather is analyzed along the entire route — for multi-day tours, each stage is evaluated separately.
seo.dateTimeDesc: Weather changes significantly throughout the day. The start time determines when the forecast is evaluated — so you get recommendations that match temperature, wind, and precipitation during your ride.
seo.bikeTypeDesc: Road bike, gravel, MTB, or city — each bike type brings different clothing and protection requirements. Road cyclists need tighter, aerodynamic clothing, while MTB riders tend to prefer rugged, weather-resistant gear.
seo.intensityDesc: Your planned effort affects how warm you'll get while riding. At a relaxed pace you cool down faster and need more insulation; at high intensity a lighter layer is often enough.
seo.distanceDesc: Optional inputs that trigger additional recommendations for longer tours or significant elevation gain — such as provisions, spare clothing, or protection for alpine conditions.
seo.multiDayDesc: Planning a tour over several days? You can specify a location for each overnight stop. Weather is calculated along the route for each stage, so you have the right gear for every day.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.locationDataText: When using the GPS feature, your location is determined to retrieve weather data. The location is not stored and is only used for the current request.
dataCollected.usageDataText: When visiting the website, technical data is automatically collected (IP address, browser type, access time). This data is used to ensure operation and is not evaluated on a personal basis.
dataCollected.accountDataText: Upon registration, we store your email address and an encrypted password. When signing in via an external provider (e.g. Google via Authentik), we receive your name and email address.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal basis
legalBasis.text: The processing of personal data is based on Art. 6(1) GDPR: consent (lit. a) for location data, contract fulfillment (lit. b) for account data, and legitimate interest (lit. f) for usage data to ensure operation and for bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile).

localStorage.title: 4. Local storage
localStorage.text1: This website uses only technically necessary local storage (localStorage) in the browser. No cookies are set and no tracking or analytics services are used.
localStorage.text2: The following keys are stored in localStorage:

keys.plannerForm: bike-weather:planner-form — Cached ride planner form data
keys.rideHistory: bike-weather:ride-history — History of past ride reports

localStorage.text3: All stored data serves exclusively the functionality of the application and is not shared with third parties. You can delete this data at any time via your browser settings.

thirdParties.title: 5. Third parties
thirdParties.weatherApiText: To retrieve weather forecasts, your selected location (coordinates) is transmitted to Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com). Open-Meteo is a free, open-source weather API. No personal data is stored by this service.
thirdParties.nominatimText: For address search and reverse geocoding, your search query or GPS coordinates are transmitted to Google Maps Platform (maps.google.com). The data is processed according to Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy). No personal data beyond the search query is stored by our application.
thirdParties.turnstileText: To protect forms (login, registration, contact) from automated abuse, Cloudflare Turnstile is used. During the check, technical data (e.g. browser characteristics) is transmitted to Cloudflare, Inc. Information: cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.
thirdParties.affiliateLinksText: Product links lead to external shops. Cookies may be set when clicking.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectification, deletion, and restriction of processing of your personal data. You can revoke your consent at any time and have a right to data portability. In case of complaints, you can contact the relevant supervisory authority.

contactPrivacy.title: 7. Contact
